resources.string: Ayikho i-Apple Watch ebhangqwe nale iPhone.
I-Phase Wake ewashini
Faka i-Phase Wake ku-Apple Watch yakho ku-app ye-Watch.
Ama-alamu avunyelwe
Vumela i-Phase Wake ukuthi isethe ama-alamu ukuze i-iPhone yakho ikwazi ukukhala njenge-alamu yokwesekwa.
Qala imodi yetafula lasembhedeni
Ukuze uthole ukuphuma kwelanga, shiya i-Phase Wake ivuliwe kushaja ubusuku bonke. Isikrini sihlala simnyama kuze kuqale ukukhanya.
Qeda
Ukuphuma kwelanga ngo-%1$s
Ayikho i-alamu enokuphuma kwelanga
I-iPhone yakho ingakhombisa ukukhanya kuphela lapho i-Phase Wake ivuliwe – qala imodi yetafula lasembhedeni ngaphambi kokulala.
Ubude bokulala nokuvama kuvela ku-Apple Health.
Vula i-Phase Wake ngaphambi kokulala ukuze iwashi lakho likwazi ukulungisa i-alamu.
I-alamu ilungisiwe ewashini
Vula i-Phase Wake ku-Apple Watch yakho ngaphambi kokulala. I-watchOS ilungisa i-alamu kuphela lapho i-app ivuliwe.
Imizuzu engu-%1$d yokuqala ayilinganiswanga – i-Apple Watch ilinganisa kuphela imizuzu engu-%2$d yokugcina ngaphambi kwesikhathi esihlosiwe.

Apple Health
Ubusuku obuvela ku-Apple Health nakwamanye ama-app nabo bungavela lapha. Ukuze ububone, qhathanisa nedatha yezempilo.
Ayikho idatha yokulala evela ku-Apple Health okwamanje. Ukulala kufanele kurekhodwe lapho, isibonelo nge-Apple Watch yakho, futhi i-Phase Wake kufanele ivunyelwe ukukufunda ku-app ye-Health.
Ubusuku obuvela kwamanye ama-app (isb. i-Apple Health) abulondolozwa – buhlala lapho futhi buvele futhi uma sekunikezwe imvume.
